response.sql:
WITH film_copies AS (
  SELECT f.film_id, f.rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS copies
  FROM film AS f
  LEFT JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  GROUP BY f.film_id, f.rating
), copy_differences AS (
  SELECT film_id, rating, copies,
         copies - AVG(copies) OVER (PARTITION BY rating) AS difference_from_rating_avg,
         copies - AVG(copies) OVER () AS difference_from_overall_avg
  FROM film_copies
)
SELECT film_id, rating, copies, difference_from_rating_avg, difference_from_overall_avg
FROM copy_differences
ORDER BY difference_from_overall_avg DESC
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Films with no inventory copies are included with a count of zero, and the averages are across all films, including those films.
